title: Receipted Codex prompt that provably never left is settled Ambiguous, not Rejected, when the runtime-config persist fails before turn/start
outcome: Receipted Codex prompt that provably never left is settled Ambiguous, not Rejected, when the runtime-config persist fails before turn/start
acceptance: On the shared Codex start-turn path, a failure to persist the runtime config (src/codex.rs, the Err arm of record_codex_runtime_config_if_runtime_matches before fail_shared_codex_turn_without_runtime_exit) notes PromptDeliveryOutcome::Rejected for the turn's receipted prompt before the turn fails, as the thread-setup failure paths in the same file already do; the other pre-write early exits of handle_shared_codex_start_turn_inner are audited the same way.
A test forces that persist failure and shows the receipt Rejected (re-queueable), never Ambiguous.
disposal_reason: Folded into the class item w-6c4fc505c4dc (Codex failures before turn/start is written settle Ambiguous), per Termal::Fable2 #2385; codex.rs:1875 is one of its listed sites.
